newsitem.title: USA: Japan's NKK Corp names president.
newsitem.headline: Japan's NKK Corp names president.

text.p: Japanese steel company NKK Corp on Monday said it named Yoichi Shimogaichi as president, effective in late June when the board of directors will formally ratify the appointment.

The company said in a statement that at that time, Shunkichi Miyoshi, currently president and chief executive, would become chairman of the board. The post has been vacant since the death of chairman Yoshinari Yamashiro in February 1996.
Shimogaichi, 62, is an executive vice president of NKK and executive director of the company's steel division.
NKK is also majority owner of National Steel Corp, Mishawaka, Ind.
